name: nephilex
description: Application security for code, dependencies, secrets, infrastructure as code, and AI/LLM apps. Shows Nephilex scanner findings as diagnostics, hovers, and quick fixes.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Nephilex does not run the scanner in Restricted Mode. Trust the workspace to enable scanning.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Nephilex scans files on the local file system.

enumDescriptions: Only scan when a command is run.
Scan a file when it is saved.
Scan a file while typing, after a short pause (see nephilex.debounceMs).
nephilex.run.description: When to scan files automatically. Nothing runs automatically in Restricted Mode.

nephilex.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after the last edit before an on-type scan starts.

nephilex.executablePath.description: Absolute path to the nephilex executable. Leave empty to search PATH. Ignored when nephilex.pythonPath is set.

nephilex.pythonPath.description: Path to a Python interpreter that has nephilex installed. When set, Nephilex runs as `python -m nephilex`.

nephilex.minSeverity.description: Only show findings at or above this severity.

nephilex.scanners.description: Scanners to run (see `nephilex scanners`). Empty runs the CLI default set.

nephilex.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the nephilex CLI, one argument per item. Output and format flags are managed by the extension and are dropped.

nephilex.offlineEnrichment.description: Pass --ai-provider heuristic --patches so hovers include offline reasoning and verified deterministic fixes. No network AI calls are made. When false, --no-ai is passed.

nephilex.timeoutSeconds.description: Fail-safe timeout for a single-file scan. The CLI process is killed when it is exceeded.

nephilex.workspaceTimeoutSeconds.description: Fail-safe timeout for a workspace scan. The CLI process is killed when it is exceeded.

nephilex.maxOutputMB.description: Maximum size of CLI output read by the extension. The scan is aborted when it is exceeded.

nephilex.mcp.enabled.description: Register the Nephilex MCP server (`nephilex mcp`) for agent mode when the editor supports the MCP server definition API.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run compile:tests && node out/test/integration/runTest.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
